messages:
Alice M: Quick asynchronous sync — we need a concise owners + dependency list for the v2 deprecation rollout. Two milestones to lock: canary toggle (target) 2024-11-12 and public cutoff 2025-01-15. Who takes SDK compat, gateway shim, and test matrix ownership? Also call out any infra deps (proxy, auth, config) we need to lock.
Brandon K: I can own SDK compatibility work and the migration guide. Need eng-runtime to confirm proxy shim behavior and whether the SDK needs special retry semantics. @Cara S can you take the shim infra side?
Cara S: I can take the gateway shim and canary infra toggles. I'll open the infra PRs tomorrow. Current plan for the flag is a rollout gate in console + toggle in infra-team ops: 
```
feature_flag: api_v2_canary
rollout: 10% -> 50% -> 100%
monitoring: errors, 95p latency, token-usage
```
Also will add an automated smoke job that hits the shim endpoints during each step.
Evan P: I'll own e2e and migration test matrix. Quick clarification: what should fallback behavior be when v2 returns incompatible payloads? Automatic fallback to v1, or fail-fast with a 422/429 so callers can surface migration errors? Prefer model-variant fallback for critical paths.
Alice M: Good question — product prefers graceful fallback where possible, but for schema-breaking changes we should surface errors. Let's define a short matrix: non-breaking -> auto-fallback, breaking -> fail-fast + clear error for SDK. Evan, can you add that to the test matrix?
Evan P: Yep, I'll add cases for non-breaking, header-level version mismatch, and schema-breaking responses. Will also include perf regressions (95p latency delta threshold).
Farah R: Legal/Compliance asked whether deprecation notices and data retention requirements are documented for Private deployments. Alice M, can you add a note to the rollout doc so Security/Compliance can review the canary timeline? :raised_hands:
Alice M: Will do — I'm updating the rollout tracker now: https://go/redwood/v2-rollout (draft). I'll assign: SDK compat -> Brandon, Shim + toggles -> Cara, E2E + matrix -> Evan, Compliance follow-up -> Farah. Anyone else we should loop in (billing, partner teams)?
deploy-bot: Scheduled: canary-toggle job created for 2024-11-12 08:00 UTC. Job will run incremental traffic slices and post results to #deploy-notifications.
Brandon K: FYI — SDK owners: I'll post a short checklist in the SDK repo with migration snippets and sample error handling. Plan to land a compatibility shim in SDK v1.14.0-rc next week.
Cara S: I'll add the smoke job and provide the runbook for canary rollback (quick commands + grafana links) in the infra PR.
Alice M: Thanks everyone — I'll follow up with a single-line owners table in the tracker and ping sales/support for partner comms. If nothing blocks, we'll kick the first canary slice on 11/12. Feel free to ping me here for quick clarifications.
